Assumptions and limits
This report contains no economics: no payback period, cash flow or feed-in tariff.
The string layout uses Trina Solar TSM-460NEG9R.28 as a reference module; the module you install can
change it.
Self-sufficiency figures describe an average household; measured values differ with each household's habits.
Without a roof plane, the yield assumes 35° tilt facing south (HTW Berlin calculator default).
Open-circuit voltage checked at −10 °C cell temperature. (Planning assumption without a published source)
MPP voltage checked at 70 °C cell temperature, with the module's Voc temperature coefficient. (Planning
assumption without a published source)
